# River of Life Christian Church

> A Spirit-led Christian church in Bangalore, India. Welcome to first-time visitors, families, and anyone exploring faith.

## Articles

Faith articles and Bible studies published by River of Life Christian Church.

- **Everyday Faith** — practical sermon reflections for everyday life (`/articles/everyday-faith/{slug}`)
- **Back to the Bible** — cell group Bible study guides (`/articles/back-to-bible/{slug}`)

Full list: https://www.rolcc.in/articles
